removed_key_reason_wrong_password: Its value was never shown to players. The reply to a wrong password now comes from the 'wrong_password' entry of this module's language file (lang/<language>.json, in the same module folder as config/login.yml), so it follows the server's language setting; edit it there (UltiKits/UltiLogin#23).
login_config_comment_login_timeout: Login timeout in seconds; players who have not logged in by then are kicked
login_config_comment_session_enabled: Enable sessions (the same IP does not need to log in again for a short time)
login_config_comment_max_register_per_ip: Maximum accounts that can be registered from one IP (0 = unlimited)
login_config_comment_gui_mode_enabled: Enable the GUI login mode (number-pad interface)
login_config_comment_gui_mode_password_l: Password length in GUI mode (1-9 digits, 4-6 recommended)
login_config_comment_gui_mode_title_logi: Title of the GUI login screen
login_config_comment_gui_mode_title_regi: Title of the GUI register screen
login_config_comment_gui_mode_title_conf: Title of the GUI confirm-password screen
login_config_comment_password_min_length: Minimum password length in command mode
login_config_comment_password_max_length: Maximum password length in command mode
login_config_comment_security_lockout_du: Lockout duration after too many failed logins, in seconds
login_config_comment_security_lockout_ty: Lockout type: IP / UUID / BOTH. Failed logins are counted per IP address, so accounts behind one address share the count. IP locks the address (every account behind it). UUID locks only the account that made the attempt that reached the limit, but that lock does not reset the shared count: until someone logs in successfully at that address, or the locked account tries again after its lock expires, any other account there that mistypes is locked on that attempt. BOTH locks both
login_config_comment_spawn_location_enab: Teleport players who are not logged in to a fixed location
login_config_comment_allowed_commands: Commands players may run before logging in
login_config_comment_blind_effect: Give players who are not logged in the blindness effect
login_config_comment_email_verification_: Cooldown before a verification code can be sent again, in seconds
login_config_comment_email_max_accounts_: Maximum accounts that can be bound to one email address
login_config_comment_email_reward_enable: Enable the reward for binding an email address
login_config_comment_email_reward_comman: Commands run as the binding reward (%player% is replaced with the player name)
log_account_row_gone: The stored account row no longer exists, so nothing was written
